description.value:
You flexibly mix acidic and poisonous alchemical compounds. Your infused items and infused effects with the poison trait can affect creatures immune to poison, and the damage becomes acid or poison, whichever the target is better affected by.

While this effect is on you, any damage you roll from an infused attack, or while you have an infused effect such as a Toxic Coating, can switch between acid and poison for each target: if a target is immune to one, it takes the other, and if it resists one of them, it takes whichever it resists less. Weaknesses are not compared.

Turn off PF2e's own Toxicologist field benefit toggle while this effect is on, because that toggle forces all such damage to acid. Use the Toxicologist field benefit (acid/poison swap) toggle on this effect to switch the automatic swap off.
